digest.component_or_area: LLM workflow and plan review modules
propositions: gate_dispatch.py at 799 LOC with only 1 line of headroom is blocking story 343b's gap-5 wiring which requires threading provider_provenance through finalize_verdict and its five call sites, three of which live in gate_dispatch.py
orchestrator.py at 796 LOC with only 4 lines of headroom contains a run-scoped context-assembly cluster that can be extracted to reduce pressure on finalize_verdict call sites

the nine modules saturating or within 20 lines of the 800-LOC cap form a blocking queue where mechanical relocation along existing call-graph seams is the unblocked approach, following precedent from prior splits of runner.py

gate_dispatch.py must be split by extracting the plan-review recovery cluster (STEP_* constants, GateContractError, _collect_step_ids, _validate_gate_step_ids, _attach_plan_review_metrics, _recover_* functions) into plan_review_recovery.py with zero test edits via re-import

orchestrator.py must be split by extracting the context-assembly cluster (assemble_* functions and helpers) into context_assembly.py, leaving finalize_verdict in place with sufficient headroom for 343b's parameter addition

the three modules already at exactly 800 LOC (passes.py, attest.py, outbound_differ.py) and the code-review gate cluster are deferred; code_review_enabled monkeypatching by string requires a design change not a relocation
